description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gravelgill Axeshark.
When Gravelgill Axeshark dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gravelgill Axeshark.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
